exact.allocation_gauge: For any constant lambda, assign lambda V_r to the edge and (1-lambda)V_r to the complementary main. Their sum remains V_Z, while the individual edge current varies with lambda.
exact.boundary_transfer: M_L(V_J)>1 and M_L(V_r)<1 imply M_L(V_J+sV_r)>0 for 0<=s<=1; no derivative of V_r is used
exact.canonical_whole_jet: V_Z=(Z,partial_x Z/L)=V_J+V_r with V_J=(J_[1],partial_x J_[1]/L) and V_r=(r_[1],partial_x r_[1]/L)
exact.chart_covariance: On an adjacent overlap, V_(J,N)+V_(r,N)=V_(J,N+1)+V_(r,N+1)=V_Z, hence Delta V_r=-Delta V_J
exact.open_invariant_target: Prove C_cross<R_diag in the required orientation, or prove the division-free Abel gap |mathsf_X|<=delta_L => |mathcal C_N|>A_L+epsilon_term. Then transfer the resulting whole-main boundary theorem to Xi with the C1 homotopy.
exact.retained_edge: The edge block is strictly clockwise in every prescribed cell and across every aligned cutoff for q>=1; it remains a component theorem for V_J
exact.route_correction: A C2 estimate would be needed only after choosing a noncanonical residual allocation and differentiating that allocated first-jet vector. It is not required by the invariant whole-jet boundary Rouche theorem.

proof_boundary: This gate proves that the global first-order remainder is canonically attached to the complete jet, that an Xi-level edge allocation and its C2 current are noninvariant, and that the certified C1 remainder is the correct whole-boundary transfer. It preserves the retained-model edge and cutoff signs and gives the exact cumulative polarization. It proves no cross-current bound, Abel gap, winding cap, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.claim: The complete normalized Xi first jet is main plus one global remainder jet.
rows.formula: V_Z=(Z,partial_x Z/L)=V_J+V_r with V_J=(J_[1],partial_x J_[1]/L) and V_r=(r_[1],partial_x r_[1]/L)
rows.proof_boundary: This identity is made only after the retained components are summed.

rows.claim: The global residual has two certified first-jet coordinates.
rows.proof_boundary: No global second x derivative is asserted here.

rows.claim: The endpoint-terminal edge is a component of the retained main.
rows.proof_boundary: The global remainder is not one of these retained atoms.

rows.claim: Allocating the global remainder to one component is nonunique.
rows.formula: For any constant lambda, assign lambda V_r to the edge and (1-lambda)V_r to the complementary main. Their sum remains V_Z, while the individual edge current varies with lambda.
rows.proof_boundary: An allocated component current is not an invariant of Xi.

rows.claim: The former four-defect expression is the current change under one chosen allocation.
rows.proof_boundary: The identity is valid, but it does not canonically define a complete Xi edge.

rows.claim: The allocated edge-current sign can change while the whole vector is held fixed by compensation.
rows.proof_boundary: The witness is algebraic and is not an asserted Xi state.

rows.claim: Differentiating an allocated first-jet residual introduces r_[1],xx.
rows.proof_boundary: This explains the apparent C2 demand without making it invariant.

rows.claim: The whole-jet boundary homotopy uses C1 scalar control and no C2 residual estimate.
rows.formula: M_L(V_J)>1 and M_L(V_r)<1 imply M_L(V_J+sV_r)>0 for 0<=s<=1; no derivative of V_r is used
rows.proof_boundary: This is a boundary-winding transfer, not pointwise interior exclusion.

rows.claim: Matched adjacent remainders compensate the main-chart jump exactly.
rows.formula: On an adjacent overlap, V_(J,N)+V_(r,N)=V_(J,N+1)+V_(r,N+1)=V_Z, hence Delta V_r=-Delta V_J
rows.proof_boundary: Chart covariance does not assign the jump to the endpoint-terminal edge.

rows.claim: The signed projective edge splice and the C1 whole-jet chart transfer have different roles.
rows.formula: Delta_cut<-h/25<0 for the retained edge; M_L(Delta J)<1/5 for the whole main chart.
rows.proof_boundary: Neither statement is promoted into an Xi-level edge current.

rows.claim: The completed edge theorem remains valid input to the retained main.
rows.formula: The edge block is strictly clockwise in every prescribed cell and across every aligned cutoff for q>=1; it remains a component theorem for V_J
rows.proof_boundary: The correction changes only the handoff, not the edge margins.

rows.claim: The projective current of the retained sum contains every pair cross current.
rows.proof_boundary: No diagonal component theorem controls the cross aggregate by itself.

rows.claim: The signed edge and interior currents create a positive diagonal reserve.
rows.proof_boundary: Strict cumulative clockwise current still requires C_cross<R_diag.

rows.claim: Strictly clockwise component currents are not closed under addition.
rows.formula: v_1=(cos(theta),-sin(theta)), v_2=(cos(3theta),-sin(3theta)); K(v_1)=-1, K(v_2)=-3, but v_1+v_2=0 at theta=pi/2
rows.proof_boundary: This is a route guard, not a counterexample to the Xi estimate.

rows.claim: The next admissible theorem is cumulative cross-current control or the endpoint-complete Abel gap.
rows.formula: Prove C_cross<R_diag in the required orientation, or prove the division-free Abel gap |mathsf_X|<=delta_L => |mathcal C_N|>A_L+epsilon_term. Then transfer the resulting whole-main boundary theorem to Xi with the C1 homotopy.
rows.proof_boundary: Every endpoint, projection pole, exceptional fibre, and cutoff join remains included.

rows.claim: The noncanonical Xi-edge C2 obligation is retired without claiming contact exclusion.
rows.formula: A C2 estimate would be needed only after choosing a noncanonical residual allocation and differentiating that allocated first-jet vector. It is not required by the invariant whole-jet boundary Rouche theorem.
rows.proof_boundary: No cumulative bound, Abel gap, winding cap, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize conclusion is proved.
